method_notes: Gathered 2026-11-12. Candidate list from the HF API (pipeline_tag=text-to-speech, sorted by likes, downloads and createdAt). Per model: HF API ?blobs=true (safetensors.total, createdAt, licence, per-file byte sizes), README/model card, config.json, GitHub READMEs, papers (arXiv), vendor blogs, runtime docs (llama.cpp, sherpa-onnx, MLX-Audio, vLLM-Omni) and the HF Open TTS Leaderboard (read through its page API). params_b = safetensors.total/1e9 when present; for .pth/.pt/.ckpt/.onnx it is counted from tensor shapes read via HTTP Range headers or taken from the card, as each params_source says; components lists codec/vocoder/encoder parts separately, which are often not in the headline figure. weights_gb = bytes/1e9 of the weight files only (listed in 'summed'), from the HF tree/API; it is download size, not runtime memory. speed metrics are kept as published: RTF = compute/audio (lower is better), 'x realtime' = audio/compute; a few sources that invert RTF were relabelled and say so in conditions. platform_id maps to hardware.json only on an exact match; H100/A100 without a stated memory size, L20, H20, M3 Max, Pi 4 etc. are null. 'by' separates project/paper figures from community ones. Nothing was estimated: values not published are null with a reason in null_reasons. Research was split into four groups (research_group a-d) under one brief; the merge was spot-checked against the raw cards (Kitten TTS 2 file sizes, Voxtral and Higgs 3 RTF tables, Qwen3-TTS latency claims). Most memory figures are NOT published: for most models the calculator will have to derive memory from weights + (for LLM backbones) KV cache via backbone_llm, and label it as an estimate.

research_notes.a: Group A. Values read 2026-11-12. Derived numbers carry arithmetic in params_source/notes. Not every model is 'small': Kitten TTS 2 is 1.7B and OmniVoice 0.8B (GPU-class; Supertone measured OmniVoice at RTF ~11 on CPU). Supertonic GitHub repo is archived (weights mirrored at supertone-oss-archive). NeuTTS repos are gated; the NeuTTS Open License 1.0 text (Nano) could not be read, so commercial status is null. Piper voice commercial status is per voice (COMMERCIAL_USE.md); Spain-Spanish davefx/sharvard/carlfm are on the list. Web search results for Piper/Kokoro speeds were secondary blogs and were NOT used; only primary pages fetched on the research date (sherpa-onnx docs, Kokoro-FastAPI README) are cited.
research_notes.b: Group B (LLM backbone + neural codec). 9 model objects (Dia2-1B, Llasa-1B, Llasa-1B-Multilingual, Zonos hybrid and the Orpheus es_it finetune are variants). Gated repos (canopylabs/*, sesame/csm-1b) return 'Access restricted' for config.json; configs were taken from ungated unsloth mirrors and are flagged. Cross-model x-realtime figures for Dia/CSM/Orpheus come from Kyutai's DSM paper Table 6 (hardware for the baselines not stated in the caption). Unverified/excluded: kyutai.org TTS page numbers (JS-only page), canopylabs.ai multilingual post (JS-only), Dia2 official VRAM/speed (none exist), Llasa speed (none published), codersera blog VRAM/speed tables (no methodology).
research_notes.c: Param counts for .pth/.ckpt checkpoints were obtained by reading only the zip central directory + data.pkl over HTTP Range with a restricted unpickler (no code executed, no weights downloaded); optimizer-state and bool-buffer tensors were excluded where present. Fish s1-mini files are gated (401) so its 0.5B is the card figure. Gigagpu.com community XTTS/F5/Chatterbox benchmark pages are Cloudflare-blocked and were not used. Speeds on NVIDIA L20 / M3 Max have platform_id null (not in list).
research_notes.d: KEY SHARED SOURCE: the HF Open TTS Leaderboard (https://huggingface.co/spaces/hf-audio/open_tts_leaderboard, v1.6.0, updated 2026-11-12) has independent TTFA/RTFx on A100, H200 and CPU (streaming, batch 1) and per-language WER/RTFx (batched, H200). All five tables (streaming A100/H200/CPU, Spanish no-clone/clone) were read and shared with the other groups (they cover Kokoro, Supertonic, OmniVoice, Chatterbox, CosyVoice3, IndexTTS-2.5, Fish S2/Drama-3, ZONOS3-Mini, NeuTTS, pocket-tts, Ming-3.0, etc.). Leaderboard A100 = HF Jobs 'a100-large' (memory not stated by the page, so platform_id left null). llama.cpp mainline: Qwen3-TTS supported since PR #26254 (merged 2026-08-04, 1.7B-Base, llama-tts, breaking change), 0.6B fixed in #28231 (2026-09-02), server /tts endpoint #26603 (2026-10-20). None of the other group-D models are in mainline llama.cpp; VoxCPM2 runs in the llama.cpp-omni fork; audio.cpp (ggml) covers Qwen3-TTS, Voxtral, VoxCPM2, VibeVoice 1.5B/7B, Higgs v3, MOSS-TTS v1.5, Magpie. faster-qwen3-tts labels its column 'RTF' but defines RTF > 1.0 = faster than real time; recorded as metric 'x realtime'.
